title: Ending currents of hyperbolic group actions
summary: We develop a theory of ending currents for properly discontinuous isometric actions of hyperbolic groups on Gromov hyperbolic spaces, generalizing Thurston's ending laminations. Several natural generalizations are considered, which agree in the 3-dimensional hyperbolic setting but are otherwise distinct.
